citation: NIST NCSTAR 1, Final Report on the Collapse of the World Trade Center Towers, September 2005. Building description, aircraft weight and fuel, impact damage, occupancy.
NIST, FAQs: WTC Towers Investigation. Collapse cause, fire and steel temperatures, floor connection capacity, collapse times, seismic record, residue testing.
NIST technical briefing, F. Sadek, Aircraft Impact Damage Analysis, September 2005. Impact speeds (443 ± 30 and 542 ± 24 mph), severed-column counts.
NIST technical briefing, K. Butler, Post-Impact Frequency Analysis, September 2005. Sway of WTC 2 after impact, 11.4-second period.
NIST technical briefings, T. McAllister and J. Gross, structural response, probable collapse sequence and response to public comments, September 2005. Inward bowing measurements, wind neglected.
NIST briefing, S. Sunder, NIST Response to the World Trade Center Disaster, October 2005. Design-wind drift (51 to 65 in at the top), occupancy.
NIST briefing, K. McGrattan, Simulation of the Fires in WTC 1 and 2. Combustible load of 3 to 5 lb per sq ft, 4 as the realistic case.
NIST NISTIR 6879, Initial Model for Fires in the World Trade Center Towers, May 2002. Wind speed and direction, tower dimensions, heat release rate near one gigawatt, early fuel estimates.
Engineering News-Record, Report Ties Trade Center Collapses to Column Failures, October 2002. The leaseholder's engineering study.
9/11 Commission Report, chapter 1, "We Have Some Planes". Flight and air defense timeline.
9/11 Commission Report, chapter 8, "The System Was Blinking Red". Summer 2001 threat reporting, the August 6 brief, Phoenix memo, Moussaoui, watchlisting.
9/11 Commission Report, chapter 11, "Foresight and Hindsight". Earlier aircraft-as-weapon warnings, missed opportunities, kinds of failure.
NIST NCSTAR 1-3, Mechanical and Metallurgical Analysis of Structural Steel. Temperatures reached by recovered steel.
National Security Archive, The President's Daily Brief of August 6, 2001. Declassification of the brief.
Snopes, quoting the 9/11 Commission on airline put options.
NBC News, Pentagon report refutes pre-9/11 intel claim, September 2006. Able Danger.
ABC News 20/20, Were Israelis Detained on Sept. 11 Spies?, June 2002.
Salon, The Israeli "art student" mystery, May 2002.
StrategyPage, Intelligence: March 12, 2002. DEA confirmation of the memo and the FBI's denial of a spy ring.
